## VaultKeeper.checkExecutableTrust() method

Check whether an executable is trusted according to the trust manifest, without modifying the manifest.

This is a read-only probe. Unlike [VaultKeeper.setup()](./vaultkeeper.vaultkeeper.setup.md)<!-- -->, it never records a hash, so it can be used to decide whether an interactive approval prompt is required before proceeding.

**Signature:**

```typescript
checkExecutableTrust(executablePath: string): Promise<ExecutableTrustStatus>;
```

**Returns:**

Promise&lt;[ExecutableTrustStatus](./vaultkeeper.executabletruststatus.md)<!-- -->&gt;

The current trust status. `trusted` is `true` only when the executable's current hash matches an approved manifest entry.
